rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for fraud involving dishonest gain, especially financial scams or crimes.

example.english: Fraud phone calls nowadays often pretend to be bank staff to trick people out of money.
example.traditional: 而家啲詐騙電話成日扮銀行職員呃人攞錢。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 di1 zaa3 pin3 din6 waa2 seng4 jat6 baan6 ngan4 hong4 zik1 jyun4 ak1 jan4 lo2 cin2

rows.note: Use this for the broader or more formal idea of deceptive cheating when financial scamming is not the main focus.

example.english: The contract involved fraud and caused the small shareholders to suffer losses.
example.traditional: 合約入面有欺詐成分，令小股東蒙受損失。
example.jyutping: hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 jau5 hei1 zaa3 sing4 fan6 ling6 siu2 gu2 dung1 mung4 sau6 syun2 sat1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the fraud involves pretending to be another person or using a false identity.

example.english: Someone committed fraud by assuming my identity and opened an online account in my name.
example.traditional: 有人冒認身份，用我個名開咗個網上戶口。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 mou6 jing6 san1 fan2 jung6 ngo5 go3 ming4 hoi1 zo2 go3 mong5 soeng6 wu6 hau2
